about.title: About Chromora Yarns | Dyed Yarn Manufacturer
about.heroDescription: Dyed yarn manufacturing and export from Keqiao, Shaoxing, China, focused on colour accuracy and long-term supply partnerships.
about.workflowDescription:
Since 2009, Chromora Yarns has built its reputation around dyed yarns that mills can run with confidence. We combine dyeing capability, winding and packaging discipline, and a commercial team that understands export timelines.

Our catalogue covers polyester textured and fully drawn dyed yarns, space-dyed and twisted constructions, nylon DTY, and cotton dyed yarn—serving apparel, home, and specialty textile customers.
about.story:
Since 2009, Chromora Yarns has built its reputation around dyed yarns that mills can run with confidence. We combine dyeing capability, winding and packaging discipline, and a commercial team that understands export timelines.

Our catalogue covers polyester textured and fully drawn dyed yarns, space-dyed and twisted constructions, nylon DTY, and cotton dyed yarn—serving apparel, home, and specialty textile customers.
about.approach:
We treat every enquiry as a specification problem first: fibre, denier, lustre, shade, MOQ, and ship date. Clear specs reduce remakes and keep your fabric calendar on track.

For recurring programs, we retain shade standards and lot history so replenishment orders stay aligned with approved references.
about.closingDescription: Looking for a stable dyed yarn source for your next season? Share your requirements and we will propose suitable constructions and sampling steps.

sections.title: Built Around Repeatable Lots
sections.body: Colour and package quality only matter if they repeat. Chromora Yarns aligns dyeing, inspection, and labelling so approved shades can be replenished with fewer surprises across seasons.

sections.title: Our Quality Focus
sections.body: In-process checks and lot IDs keep approved shades replenishable.
items: Incoming & process control — Monitor key dyeing and winding parameters against work orders.
Shade approval discipline — Lab dips and sealed standards before bulk where required.
Fastness & physical checks — Test to the protocol named in the purchase order.
Traceability — Lot IDs on packages and documents for mill receiving.

sections.title: Certifications & Compliance
sections.body: We maintain OEKO-TEX Standard 100 and can share current certificate copies with qualified buyers. Additional customer-specific audits or restricted-substance declarations can be discussed during onboarding. Certificate scope and validity dates are confirmed at order time—request the latest PDF with your RFQ.

sections.title: Ask for Our Latest Certificates
sections.body: Email sales@chromora-yarns.com or submit the contact form with your company name and target markets.

privacy.content: Chromora Yarns uses contact details you submit on this website to respond to quotes, sample requests, and commercial questions. We do not sell enquiry data. To update or delete information you have sent us, email sales@chromora-yarns.com.

terms.content: Content on this website is provided for product information and enquiry only. Specifications, MOQs, and lead times are confirmed in writing on each order. polyester-dyed-yarn.title: Polyester Dyed Yarn
polyester-dyed-yarn.description: Polyester DTY, FDY, space-dyed, and twisted dyed yarns from Chromora Yarns.
polyester-dyed-yarn.content: This hub covers Chromora Yarns’ polyester dyed yarn families: DTY, FDY, space dyed, and twisted constructions. Open a product page for denier ranges, finishes, and typical end uses—or request a shade card and sample set.

polyester-dty.title: Polyester DTY
polyester-dty.description: Dyed polyester draw textured yarn for soft hand, comfort stretch, and reliable colour in circular knits and related fabrics.
polyester-dty.content:
Polyester DTY is a core workhorse for dyed filament programs. Texturing adds bulk and a pleasant hand, while package dyeing delivers consistent colour across cones for knitting and selected weaving uses.

Chromora Yarns supplies dyed DTY across commonly requested deniers and lustres. Share your gauge, fabric type, and shade standard—we will propose suitable filament counts and sampling steps.

Export packing and lot labelling support mills that need clear intake records for multi-country garment programs.
polyester-dty.ctaBody: Request a sample set or send your denier and colour brief for a commercial quote.

polyester-fdy.title: Polyester FDY
polyester-fdy.description: Fully drawn dyed polyester filament for smooth surfaces, dimensional stability, and clean fabric appearance.
polyester-fdy.content:
FDY is chosen when fabrics need a smoother, more stable filament character than textured yarn. Dyed FDY supports weaving, embroidery bases, and constructions where lustre and evenness matter.

Chromora Yarns offers dyed FDY options across practical denier bands. Tell us your end fabric and preferred lustre so we can align filament selection and colour development.

We support both catalogue colours and custom matching for seasonal programs, with samples before bulk commitment.
polyester-fdy.ctaBody: Request a sample set or send your denier and colour brief for a commercial quote.

polyester-space-dyed-yarn.description: Multi-colour segments dyed along the yarn length for distinctive multi-tone effects in carpets, rugs, fashion knits, and decorative fabrics.
polyester-space-dyed-yarn.content: Multi-colour segments dyed along the yarn length for distinctive multi-tone effects in carpets, rugs, fashion knits, and decorative fabrics.

polyester-space-dyed-yarn.applicationsIntro: Space dyed polyester yarn is commonly selected for:
applications: Fashion knitwear with multi-tone surface interest
polyester-space-dyed-yarn.applicationsNote: Designers use space dyed yarn to build depth and movement in the fabric without relying solely on piece dyeing—helpful when pattern and colour placement are part of the product story.
polyester-space-dyed-yarn.qc: Each production lot is checked against the approved shade reference for segment clarity and overall tone. We monitor colourfastness targets agreed in the order, package winding quality, and labelling so receiving mills can trace lots. Certificates and test summaries can be provided with shipments when specified in the PO.
polyester-space-dyed-yarn.moq: Minimum order quantities depend on whether you select catalogue shades or a custom multi-colour program. Share your monthly volume and destination; we will confirm MOQ, sampling timeline, and bulk lead time in writing. Rush sampling may be available for priority programs—ask when you submit the brief.

twisted-yarn.title: Twisted Yarn
twisted-yarn.description: Dyed twisted polyester yarn for enhanced strength, fabric character, and embroidery or crepe-oriented programs.
twisted-yarn.content:
Twisting changes yarn behaviour—adding cohesion, strength, and surface interest that many woven and embroidery applications require. Combined with dyeing, twisted yarn supports both functional and aesthetic goals.

Chromora Yarns produces twisted dyed yarns in single and multi-ply constructions as agreed with the buyer. Specify TPM/TPI targets, base denier, and shade references in your enquiry.

QC focuses on twist regularity, shade alignment, and package build suitable for high-speed take-up.
twisted-yarn.ctaBody: Request a sample set or send TPM/TPI, base denier, and shade references for a quote.

nylon-dty.title: Nylon DTY
nylon-dty.description: Dyed nylon textured yarn for strength, smooth recovery, and fine-gauge apparel applications.
nylon-dty.content:
Nylon DTY is valued for toughness and a smooth dyed appearance in activewear, intimates, hosiery, and fine knits. Colour consistency across lots helps brands keep trim and body fabrics aligned.

Chromora Yarns supplies dyed nylon DTY for buyers who need clear denier options and responsive sampling. Share stretch, opacity, and shade requirements with your RFQ.

We coordinate packaging and documents for export destinations and can align test expectations with your QA checklist.

specs.value: e.g. common fine deniers — confirm RFQ

nylon-dty.ctaBody: Request a sample set or send stretch, opacity, and shade requirements for a quote.

cotton-dyed-yarn.title: Cotton Dyed Yarn
cotton-dyed-yarn.description: Soft, breathable dyed cotton yarn for apparel, terry, and lifestyle textile programs.
cotton-dyed-yarn.content:
Cotton dyed yarn brings natural hand and comfort to knitted and woven goods. Reliable dyeing and even winding help mills reduce shade-related downtime on long runs.

Chromora Yarns offers cotton dyed yarn across practical count ranges for apparel and home textiles. Provide count, twist, and colour standard (Pantone or physical swatch) when requesting samples.

Ask for fastness targets appropriate to your end use—wash, rub, and light—so lab validation matches buyer expectations.
cotton-dyed-yarn.ctaBody: Request a sample set or send count, twist, and colour standard for a quote.
